feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 1 September 2026 4:29pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 01 September 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the north and west of Britain, with various fronts affecting the Irish Sea at times over the next few days.


##Wind##

Southwest 4 or 5, decreasing 3 or 4 this evening or tonight, then backing South or Southeast 3 or 4 tomorrow morning. Veering South or Southwest in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain at times, risk of mist patches for a time tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate at times in rain, poor in any mist patches tomorrow.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4, veering West or Southwest overnight into Thursday and increasing mainly 5, possibly occasionally touching 6 in places, then decreasing 4 or 5 on Thursday morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Patchy rain at first, then fair.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain at first.
